recipes.name: Easy Lemon Cake Cookies with Icing

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Line baking sheets with foil.

Mix together cake mix, eggs, and vegetable oil. Drop by rounded teaspoons onto baking sheets and bake for no more than 8 minutes. Do not overbake! Once all the cookies are done. Remove the foil. You have a no need to clean baking sheet.

To Make Lemon Icing: Mix together confectioners' sugar, lemon extract, and milk. Mix ingredients together (more or less to your desired liking). When the cookies are warm or completely cooled, place as much icing on them as you like!

review.reviewBody: Fantastically easy and yummy! I also tried this recipe with orange cake mix with orange extract in the frosting and served it at a meeting of Very Fussy Ladies who raved about them. I do agree that they are best baked exactly 8 minutes, no more, no less.

my dessert loving family with a passion for anything "sweet & lemon flavored" is such a fan of this simple & delightfully tasty cookie...SO quick & easy to prepare with little cleanup required... like several other reviewers i made a few changes to "pump" up the flavor factor a bit..i add a teaspoon of lemon extract to the batter as well as some finely grated zest [& a good "squirt" of juice} from a fresh lemon...by the way, i wouldn't even bother making these unless you use freshly squeezed lemon juice...wash & dry your lemons well, & then with a little pressure using your hands, roll them back & forth across your countertop to soften up & make them easier to juice. for the icing all i add is fresh lemon juice [to taste...for my family a generous amount] to the powdered sugar. you don't want it too thick like traditional icing but more a glaze consistency to generously pour over the tops of the cookies as soon as you take them out of the oven...the glaze will quickly set up & dry leaving you a cookie with a perfect balance of sweet and tart flavors. once they've been in the oven a few minutes & puff up i use a spatula to flatten then continue baking til the edges are golden brown-i go more by color than time.

I make these without the icing, but I add 1/2 cup white chocolate chips into the mix and bake exactly 8 1/2 minutes. Cool them on a cookie rack. My kids love these. I use to make them for their class parties when they were younger!

Everyone in my family LOVED these cookies, but I made a few adjustments. They were cooked all the way through at 8 mins, it took closer to 10, we like chewy cookies so 11 minutes was the spot on time for me. I tried these with 3 different 'toppings' and took them to a family get together and asked for everyone's opinions, of course everyone likes something different, but all 3 of the following were raved about and the recipe was asked for. I make my homemade frosting (basically like the one listed above - butter, little milk, conf. Sugar, lemon flavor), glaze drizzle (conf. Sugar and water, and moms absolute fav. Was rolled in conf. Sugar before baking. Now with this option I will say this is a very thick but sticky batter so just rub a bit of sugar on your hands first and don't keep the dough I. Your hands longer than needed to form a ball. They come out perfect and this is definitely a keeper recipe for me and I am going to try it in other flavors.

i'm rating it three stars only because i tweeked the recipe. instead of the lemon cake mix i used yellow; instead of the two eggs i used a 3.5 oz pkg of lemon pudding, and instead of veg oil i used the same ammount of melted veg shortening (same thing isn't it???) i only tweeked it because i wanted something lemon-y and i didnt have a lemon cake mix or eggs or veg oil. turned out great! i couldnt get the cookies off the cookie sheet until they were TOTALLY cooled, and even then i had to be very careful. so.. i think spraying the pan with a little pam and then wiping the pan with a paper towel when i did the next batch was a little easier. oh, and i baked them for 10 mins.
I added. Teaspoon of lemon extract to the batter. Baked for 9 minutes. Really good!

So good!! They are a cookie with a cakey texture! Pour the icing on top so good! I put two tablespoons of whip cream, juice from a lemon in it and a cup of white chocolate! Use a teaspoon to drop them down. They take longer 12 minutes. New favorite cookie!

These were okay. I was hoping they would be similar to Maggiano's lemon cookies but the middles were chewy/doughy after even 10 minutes of baking. Perhaps you need to press them down flat before baking instead of "dropping by rounded teaspoons"???? I also had to double the milk in the icing.
Simple to make and delicious. I only had yellow cake mix so I put 2 tablespoons of lemon extract in the cookie mix and and an extra teaspoon lemon extract in the frosting.
Easy and delicious is my kind of baking. I added a bit more lemon extract to the glaze to bring out more of the lemon taste. Topped with some dried summer berries/sugar it is a great summer cookie.

great recipe. I have used several different cake mixes and love the Carmel cookies. I use dark cocoa candy melts and add a chocolate bottom. I've also sprinkled crumbled bacon on the chocolate. these are a huge hit.
Delicious cookies my family devours!
These are so easy to make and everyone at work LOVED them!! Making again for sure!!
So easy to make an absolutely delicious I couldn’t even get them all iced before the family started eating them. They’re great without the icing and awesome with it.

The cookies tasted like some I used to get from a bakery near a clinic. Each time I had to take one of my daughters to the doctor, we’d always stop by for cookies. One of our favorites was the lemon. So I tried these, and my daughter loved them. Will definitely make them again, perhaps with a different cake mix such as spice.
These cookies were easy to make and everyone loved them!
Love these cookies! So light and lemony...I rolled them in confectionary sugar before baking. They came out terrifically!!
These cookies came out amazing! The only thing I did differently was add a few drops of lemon essential oil to the batter for more lemon flavor.
Very easy to make, it hard to bake. Be aware they are very moist at firsts, but if you overcook, they are dry. Overall very yummy and easy to make.
The recipe is very simple, quick, and easy however mine came out extremely flat.
